quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Bakelite semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-06-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April-September 2025, IFRS): revenue rose 2.2% year over year to JPY 156,528 million on strong demand for semiconductor applications, although overseas demand for automotive mechanical parts was weak; business profit rose 8.2% to JPY 17,118 million and operating profit rose 5.1% to JPY 16,462 million. Semiconductor materials segment: revenue JPY 51,256 million (up 11.1%), business profit JPY 10,196 million (up 8.5%). Management states epoxy molding compound revenue rose on continued strong semiconductor demand within China plus expanding demand for AI-related applications; photosensitive materials rose on the memory market recovery from the second quarter; bonding pastes rose on strong China domestic demand, new sales in China and high-density packages in Southeast Asia.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 156,528 million (+2.2%); semiconductor materials revenue JPY 51,256 million (+11.1%), business profit JPY 10,196 million (+8.5%)
